images.caption:
An airplane shot of the island chain of Kepulauan Seribu to the north of Jakarta. The direction of north is approximately 10 o'clock in this photo.
The picture is centered on the densely populated Kelapa-Harapan Island in the center, the island is linked with a bridge on the east-west direction as well as a pier to the south.  

To the north of the island is a rectangular shaped Panjang Island, the only island in Kepulauan Seribu which contains a landing strip.
